stories.title: Tropical Cyclone Wati intensifies near Suwarrow, with Aitutaki on alert
stories.location: Cook Islands: Northern Group near Suwarrow (RSMC Nadi storm centre 12.1S 163.0W at 161800Z, open water); forecast track toward Aitutaki, Southern Group
stories.summary: Tropical Cyclone Wati is strengthening as it moves southeast through the northern Cook Islands, with a cyclone warning in force for Suwarrow atoll and a cyclone alert for Aitutaki in the south.

stories.title: Tropical Storm Champi heads toward Guam as governor declares emergency
stories.location: Guam and Northern Mariana Islands (storm centre approx. 11.6N 150.8E, open ocean)
stories.summary: Tropical Storm Champi is moving west across the open Pacific toward Guam, and forecasters expect it to strengthen into a typhoon before it passes over or very near the island.

stories.title: Satellite monitors flag low-impact forest fires in Botswana and Mozambique
stories.summary: A global disaster-alert system has recorded four forest fires in southern Africa this month: one in northern Botswana and three in central Mozambique. The system rated all four at its lowest alert level.
stories.location: Chobe District, Botswana; Zambezia province, Mozambique
stories.update_note: Adds GDACS 1032672 (32,246 ha, Zambezia) and GDACS people-in-burned-area counts; limits burning-season context to Botswana.

stories.title: Indonesia battles worst forest fires in over a decade as haze spreads across region
stories.alert_level: GDACS Green (lowest) for all four mapped events
stories.summary: Indonesia is fighting its worst forest and land fires in more than a decade, The Independent reported Friday. Four members of a firefighting team died, and the government has agreed to accept foreign help.
stories.location: Indonesia (national; GDACS events in South Sumatra, West Papua, South Papua, North Maluku)

stories.title: Deep magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes Fiji region, no tsunami threat
stories.summary: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck deep beneath the sea in the Fiji region at 10:49 GMT on Oct. 14, the U.S. Geological Survey reported.

stories.title: Satellite alert flags low-impact wildfire in northeastern Nigeria
stories.summary: A wildfire burned about 7,464 hectares, roughly 18,400 acres, in far northeastern Nigeria from Oct. 7 to Oct. 14, according to the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System.

stories.title: Flash flooding in Tripoli kills at least one, prompts investigation
stories.summary: Torrential rain flooded Libya's capital, Tripoli, on Tuesday, killing at least one person, the Libya Herald reported. Some reports put the death toll at two.

stories.title: Tropical Storm Simon weakens off Mexico's Baja California coast
stories.summary: Tropical Storm Simon is weakening over open water south of Mexico's Baja California peninsula, and forecasters expect it to fall apart this weekend, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said Friday.
